Chapter 10: Embracing Change and Looking Forward
Change—it's the only thing we can really count on, isn’t it? But let’s be honest, just knowing that doesn’t make it any less intimidating. As the year winds down, our young woman looks back on everything that’s shifted, both around her and within her. The anxiety’s still there, sure, but it’s not so overwhelming anymore. It’s softened—almost like an old friend, rather than a voice that takes over her world.
And even though the future is still full of unknowns, those uncertainties don’t feel quite so towering. She feels grateful, looking back at the journey—every setback, every laugh, and each little moment of connection. She-Devil, her dog, is a bit older these days. Not quite as wild, but every bit as loving. Their bond has only grown deeper, shaped by the tough days and the everyday joys they’ve shared.
Picture this: one evening, she’s walking through her neighborhood. The air is crisp, the sky painted with soft pinks. And in that quiet moment, she feels a kind of peace. The unknowns are still there, but now, she trusts herself a little more to handle whatever comes next. All those lessons from the past year—about being open, bouncing back, and soaking in the small joys—those have become a part of her.
You know, most of us don’t even realize how much strength we’ve built until we pause and look over our shoulder, just to see how far we’ve actually come. Growing up? It never really ends. It’s a mix of new beginnings, bittersweet endings, and everything messy in between. And that journey? It’s never perfect, but it’s absolutely your own.
So as she heads home, She-Devil trotting happily beside her, it hits her: the real work of adulthood isn’t about having every answer. It’s about living with the questions, finding meaning in all the beautiful chaos, and just keeping on—one step, one day, one wagging tail at a time.
